report_comment.text: IGH is the immunoglobulin heavy-chain locus involved in B-cell antigen-receptor diversity. FGFR3 encodes a fibroblast growth factor receptor tyrosine kinase. NSD2 encodes a SET-domain chromatin regulator. In plasma cell myeloma, rearrangements involving IGH and the FGFR3/NSD2 region were detected by FISH and mapped by optical genome mapping. The primary cohort documented 12 such events with different breakpoints.
